name: world_state_gate_v1
guideline: You read one short news item (a headline and a one or two sentence description).
Reply with the JSON object only: {"change": true or false}.

change is true only if the item reports, or gives a real reason to expect, that some condition of a place is rising or falling for the people there: prices, housing, jobs, health, safety, hunger, water, energy, supply, environment, security, trust, technology use and similar. A single crime, accident, arrest, sports result, product launch, company announcement, plan, demand or opinion with no clear effect on such a condition is false.

input.text: Varnel port workers strike over pay. Cargo handling at the fictional port of Varnel stopped for a second day, and shop shelves are emptying.
Council names new library director. The council of the fictional town of Orlin appointed a former teacher to lead its library.
